prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Church takes delight in styling her founder "THE AMIABLE JESUS," and He likewise says of Himself, "I am meek and humble of heart."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A Igreja deleita-se em chamar o seu fundador "O AMÁVEL JESUS," e Ele mesmo diz de Si: "Sou manso e humilde de coração."

meta.face: A Frank of Picardy of about eighty-five, hale and HEAVY-BONED, with a ruddy, weathered complexion and a big, SQUARE face with a strong, BROAD jaw — a high, BALD, DOMED crown with a fringe of short white hair, a LONG, strong, gently HOOKED nose, LARGE ears, eyes squeezed into merry CRESCENTS by laughter under BUSHY white brows lifted at the centre, deep laugh lines, a WIDE mouth OPEN in a hearty laugh that shows a little of the upper teeth (the laughing Medard of tradition), and a SHORT, SQUARE-CUT, close white beard that follows the jaw; the gaze warm and full of joy.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book tells a noble of Salency, born about 457, compassionate to the poor from childhood, made bishop in 530 at seventy-two and dead in 545 at an advanced age; its engraving shows the bishop holding a wreath over a bowing maiden. Wikipedia (en and fr) says he is most often shown with the eagle that sheltered him from rain, and often laughing with his mouth open (invoked against toothache), and that the Rosière of Salency is said to go back to him. The heavy-boned, laughing face is our reading of that tradition.
